name: btn-bg-shine
title: Background Shine Button
description: A single large rounded button labelled Click Me, filled with a blue-violet gradient that slides continuously. Its thin outline turns bright white while the pointer is over it.
use: A single primary action should stand out on a dark page without needing icons or extra layout.
avoid: The fill and label colours are fixed blue on white text, so it will not blend into an arbitrary brand palette.
a11y: The visible label and a focus ring make it usable, but the looping sheen never pauses for reduced-motion users. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide rounded rectangle in deep blue-violet holds a bold white label centred on it. A soft lighter band drifts diagonally across the fill, and a thin lavender outline sits at rest, becoming a thick white border on hover.
behaves: The gradient background loops from edge to edge, so a pale sheen keeps travelling across the button. Hovering replaces the thin lavender outline with a bright white one that lifts the button off the dark stage.
customise: The label text, gradient stops and border colours are written into the class names, so changing them means editing the file; it takes no props.
weight: light: One button and one looping CSS gradient, with no JavaScript at all.
